test_gate_protection.mechanism: Sequential step ordering; any non-zero exit code from npm test halts execution before Docker Build step

image_tagging.tag_scheme: myservice:${{ github.sha }} and ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }}
image_tagging.immutability: Git commit SHA provides exact traceability to commit tree

secrets_safety.credential_provider: GitHub Secrets and ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} with automated masking (***)
secrets_safety.hardcoded_secrets: None. Zero plain text secrets in YAML or repository files.

conceptual_analysis.simultaneous_pushes: Handled via GitHub Actions concurrency groups or build queuing; cancel-in-progress avoids wasting runner minutes on stale commits.
conceptual_analysis.pipeline_latency: 8-minute feedback loops degrade developer momentum. Optimized via npm lockfile caching, fail-fast order (static analysis before tests before image build), and multi-stage layer caching.
